The '''2025–26 Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball team''' represented [[Texas A&M University]] during the [[2025–26 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team was led by first-year head coach [[Bucky McMillan]] and played their home games at [[Reed Arena]] located in [[College Station, Texas]] as a member of the [[Southeastern Conference]].

==Previous season==
The [[2024–25 Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball team|Aggies]] finished the [[2024–25 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2024–25 season]] 23–11, 11–7 in [[2024–25 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC play]] to finish in fifth place. In the [[2025 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]]. They were upset in their very first game in the second round by rival [[2024–25 Texas Longhorns men's basketball team|Texas]] in double-overtime. The Aggies received an at-large bid to the [[2025 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA Tournament]] as a No. 4 seed in the South Region, where they defeated [[2024–25 Yale Bulldogs men's basketball team|Yale]] in the first round before falling to [[2024–25 Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team|Michigan]] in the second round.<ref>{{cite web |title=2024-25 Texas A&M Aggies Men's Schedule and Results |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/schools/texas-am/men/2025-schedule.html |website=Sports Reference |access-date=9 November 2025}}</ref>

Following the season, on April 1, 2025, then-head coach [[Buzz Williams]] left the team to become the head coach at [[Maryland Terrapins men's basketball|Maryland]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-04-01 |title=Maryland hires Buzz Williams: Terps poach Texas A&M coach to replace Kevin Willard after controversial exit |url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/maryland-hires-buzz-williams-terps-poach-texas-a-m-coach-to-replace-kevin-willard-after-controversial-exit/ |access-date=2025-04-01 |website=CBSSports.com |language=en}}</ref> Three days later, on April 4, 2025, the school named [[Samford Bulldogs men's basketball|Samford]] head coach [[Bucky McMillan]] the team's new head coach.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-04-05 |title=Texas A&M names McMillan as men's hoops coach |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/44537561/texas-hire-samford-bucky-mcmillan-coach |access-date=2025-10-03 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}}</ref>
